title: The two-fifths admissibility obstruction for scaling-sharp Strichartz estimates of Dirichlet waves on the two-dimensional Friedlander convex model
author: Oana Ivanovici; Gilles Lebeau; Fabrice Planchon
work: New counterexamples to Strichartz estimates for the wave equation on a $2$D model convex domain
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.168

original_source_record.kind: Original raster scale illustration extracted with its original soft mask; no reconstruction/redrawing or mathematical proof inside this asset.

difficulty_reason: The cited dispersive parametrix does not itself produce the stronger necessary Strichartz exponent condition. The author constructs a localized family of initial data, isolates the accumulated reflected-wave contribution through the Airy-Poisson phase analysis, and compares the exact initial L2 norm with its spacetime Lr concentration. Optimizing the printed three scales gives the new two-fifths obstruction, with the supporting Airy and orthogonality proofs retained.
